instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains two separate horizontal line sketches on the XY plane. Sketch Line_A runs from (-20, 0, 0) to (20, 0, 0), and Sketch Line_B runs from (-20, 20, 0) to (20, 20, 0). Use the Part workbench Ruled Surface tool to create one ruled surface directly between these two supplied line sketches. Do not close the two lines into a planar face; the result should be an open rectangular surface spanning the two parallel lines. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
